title_zh: 同一 8.4 米概念带的三种布局对照
title_en: Three layouts within the same conceptual 8.4 m band
authority_boundary: All dimensions are participant-authored design targets for comparison. They are not surveyed widths, road redlines, accessibility certification, engineering design, or approved controls.

common_test_frame.emergency_test: A continuous 2.8 m human-priority spine must remain free when every machine is stopped.
common_test_frame.yield_bay_interval_rule: Bays are tested at 36 m centres; maximum one-way distance to a bay is therefore 18 m.

alternatives.reason_zh: 机器路径最短，但没有连续的人类优先净空，也没有可验证的侧向退出条件。
机器方向清楚，但人被分到两侧，门户和横向公共服务会重复跨越机器道。

alternatives.name_zh: 连续人行脊 + 侧置让路湾
alternatives.name_en: Continuous human spine + side yield bays
alternatives.reason_zh: 人类路径连续、机器能侧向退出、故障后可恢复普通公共空间；代价是机器路径指数比全混行高 18%。

selected_tradeoff.unfavourable_result: machine_path_index is 1.18, eighteen percent longer than ALT-A
accepted_because: human-machine crossings fall from 6 to 1 per 100 m in the concept test
a 2.8 m continuous human-priority spine remains available in the power-off test
every machine position is within 18 m of a side yield bay
selected_tradeoff.switch_rule: If field survey cannot retain the 2.8 m human spine, or if machine detour creates unsafe service pressure, do not compress the human path: downgrade to time-separated L1 operation or relocate the machine route.
